book.name: 2 KORINTA
book.title: 2 Korinta Yeisu ana totugugunayao Korinta goiadi leta aiyuwoina

content: E Tauyana taiyao kaapaisewa, tauna nakae kakawanoi makimaki ina kanuwóiya kouyaōne go, anuwoiyayana kotagōne yawoimi goi ikeuwoe.
Moitamo. Yaubadayana idigo kana,
‘Tuta ana toboine goi anovem, e akatumapu; nakae am yava ana maliyalina goi ao avaitem.’ Aiseya 49:8
Konōve! Ame tuta moe tuta ana toboineyana. Konōve! Ame moe ami yava ana maliyalinayana.
Geya kada tayaamo aba kapusi tomota idi numisa goi kayato geya, govila bei tomota itoboinedi ima paisewayana sitagiwoi.

Go sem kakamoitamoema kai Yaubada ina tovaitayao, tauna dogoi liliudi goi toinima kavagitakoima yaimi be itoboinemi konumisema go, dogoiyadi liliudi goi kamesayágana gagaina. Dogoiyadi ame nakae: Ima mou goi, o ima gedageda goi, o ima kaiyakomou goi,
o ama láuwo goi, o ima tuta deri goi, o ama vakaleya goi, o ima poisógana gagaina goi, o nakae geya kamasiisi dókana, o ima loga goi.
Ima paisewayana goi mama sinapu maavadaina, mama nanamsa, mama mesayágana, mama yabobona, mama kaiguyau, Baloma Kimaasabaina goi, mama matakoi mooitamoina,
mama bóbwara mooitamoina be nakae Yaubada ina togaga goi. Mama kaipíyama nimakakataima be nimakekelima goi kaguuinuwa. Ima kaipiyamayadi moe Yaubada ina kibóbwata ina kanasíuna manuna.
Tomota maniyedi sitaimaminema go, maniyedi sikisobuyema. Maniyedi sikaogoyoema go, maniyedi sikaodedevinema. Ima paisewa goi nakona tomota siwowokoima bego kai tovasuláiga go, kai kabóbwara moitamo.
Nakona geya yoimamo tomota maniyedi yaidi go, maniyedi yaidi kai maa yoima. Nakona ámasa ivakaosima go, konove, nava maa yawoima. Nakona dábina kababane go, geya kakamaseta.

Nakona mama nuwomou go, tuta liliuna kaauyáwana. Nakona katokai go, esaesa mooitamoina kakaiguyauye tomota badabadaidi yaidi. Nakona poyapoya ame goi kai geya konamamo go, yábana konanina liliudi sikaaiyaka yaima.
Paulo ina kawanoi bego da Korinta siuyaone
Geya kada giyaiina ima nuwonúwana kavagagale yaimi geya, go sem madabokiina kalumavivisi yaimi! Komi da Korinta, atema madabokina goi ima matakoi bogina kakaiwoduwe yaimi!
E kai ima matakoi geya kavagagalakoimita go, komi imi matakoi kovagagaalekoima.
E ima matakoi nakae kokatumāpu, e atemi goi komatakoiyēma. Ame nakae komi natugowo, tauna alatuwokoimi.
Taabu tauyadi geya sinuumiseta taiyao koospwagōgana. Moe moitamo. Manakae? Kibóbwata be apipilova itoboinedi sispwagógana? Geya. Manakae? Mavada itoboine mamaníwana taiyao sikabivekoveko? Geya.
E manakae? Guyau be Beliyala
itoboinedi taiyao sieboda tayamo? Geya. Manakae? Kita tonumisa be kidi geya sinumiseta ida nuwonúwana sivavasa? Geya.

E manakae? Yaubada polapola itoboinedi Yaubada mooitamoina ina Vada Kimaasabaina goi sikaaiyaka? Geya ae? Moe moitamo. Kita Yaubada maa yawoina ina Vada Kimaasabaina, yaida goi ikaaiyaka, tauna taabu basaleliu taiyao taaebōda tayamo. Moe nakae Tauyana idige kana,
‘Yaidi goi bei akaaiyaka be nakae yaidi goi aaketoiya. Yau bei idi Yaubada go, kidi yau guna bodao.’ Vininabeso 26:11-12
Tauna kana,
‘“Tauyadi geya sinumiseguta yaidi goi kosowōduwo; taabu dogoi baailidi kobisiikonēdi, e bei auyaonemi”, Yauwe kaena.’ Aiseya 52:11
Nakae kana,
‘“Yau bei komi Tamami go, komi yau natugowo koroto be vevina”, Yauwe Tokalika kaena.’ 2 Samwera 7:14
Tauna taabu tauyadi geya sinuumiseta taiyao koospwagōgana!

footnotes.text: Beliyala: Ame Kaleya yoina tayamo nakae go, ana yagoina moe geya basabasainamo.
